review_method: Read each linked page, compared its concepts with existing notes and the revised local AQA specification. Retained existing worked examples, tables and diagrams. Additions use original wording and examples.

coverage_decisions.decision: Retained PAN/LAN/WAN, media comparison and conditional security. Added bandwidth versus delay and whole-route bottlenecks. Did not import fixed 10 m Bluetooth ranges, AirDrop-as-Bluetooth-only, or speed-of-light as a complete throughput explanation.
Reviewed bus/star source page; these topologies are not named requirements of revised AQA 3.5. Did not add a compulsory topology section or flashcards.

Kept the six required protocol names and four layers. Added an original lost/out-of-order data example and routing/reliability/encryption distinction. FTP/UDP and detailed Ethernet/Wi-Fi protocol families were not added as required material.

Retained accurate MAC spoofing and HTTPS limits. Did not import permanent-unchangeable MAC address or blanket encrypted-messaging guarantees. Added focussed cards on each security control’s distinct job.

checks.browser_review: Passed all topic reading groups and expanded deck at 1366, 390 and 320 pixels. Checked print visibility, hidden sources, focus, keyboard controls, long prose and code answers.
